purpose: The essential operational path of PEE, stage by stage. tests/vertical_contract.test.ts fails if a named component disappears, a cited test file is missing, or a status is not one of the defined classes. Update this file in the same commit as any change to a stage's connection or status (principles 2 and 10).

statusClasses.authentic_verified: implemented and verified with authentic data on the operational path
statusClasses.synthetic_verified: implemented and verified only with synthetic data
statusClasses.disconnected: implemented but not reachable from the request path
statusClasses.blocked: implemented but blocked by missing authorisation or authentic evidence

the test readers (Phase225/226/265, 269, 270) flatten HTML with regex and never receive the Phase245 DOM, regions or table grid; the Step 1D-A2 semantic-document contract (src/document_semantics.ts) and its structured test-table reader run in evaluation and shadow only (--shadow-semantics; methodCue 'structured_table_measurement_term' is not admitted by screenTestLead265, so nothing reaches the store). Development pages: +26 correct values on the Phase272 untouched set (not held-out); untouched validation (Step 1D-B, 10 new pages, 3 publishers, first run 4bc6c35): +3 correct values, all from structural identity, 0 from the table reader (its test-context gate does not recognise the new publisher templates), 0 new wrong values; benefit partial, not transferred; revise on development evidence before any integration

the base (no-plan) test-lead reader changed behaviour after Phase265 without a version change (TEST_LEAD_EXTRACTOR265 kept so the historical identity stays): on a store copy, 2 of the 12 stored measurements of 17 authentic revisions are no longer produced by today's base reader and stay current after a same-version re-observation, and 2 new ones are produced. Plan-guided readings are now versioned by their configuration (Step 3); bumping the base version, which re-derives every revision, needs an owner decision (Step 4)

a newly restrictive rights decision under the SAME reader version may withhold a new write while an earlier observation of that version stays current (code-review suspicion after Step 3; no matching fixture yet). Step 4 must demonstrate or refute it with a fixture and define conservative retirement

reconsideration (readingsToReconsider265) is row-based: a valid reading that produced zero measurements leaves no row and may not be offered for re-examination when scientific knowledge improves (Step 1D-B: 5 of 10 unseen pages yield no reference value, 3 of them client-rendered). Step 4 must verify this and let unsuccessful readings take part in later learning through the existing journal, without a parallel evidence database

the shared plan-guided test reader (all arms, unchanged since Phase272) turns declared figures into test leads: on the unseen pages 21 of 87 reference declarations (certified CADR, motor wattage, tank capacity, packaging times) are read as leads in arms A, B and C alike, and 0 of the 18 correct leads carry the reference test condition (88 of 89 reference values state one). Leads stay unreviewed and unpersistable, so nothing reaches ranking; any persistence of plan-guided readings (Step 4) needs a declaration screen and condition capture first

the production Phase245 specification path (buildTableGrid245 / interpretTableGrid245) reads a placeholder corner cell ("Header Cell - Column 0", "Row 0 - Cell 0") as a label and flips orientation, so specification facts take a property label as product (confirmed on 2 of 18 sampled tables; none of these facts is in the live store). Lesson TL8 records the correction but is not applied: it changes the production path, outside the table-understanding assignment (docs/plans/table-understanding-audit-and-learning.md)

table readings rarely carry their test condition (F-T5): with every shadow table lesson 4 of 57 sampled reads that need a condition carry one (setting rows and columns only); conditions stated in headings, method prose or column groups are not attached. A certified rating whose declaration evidence lies outside the table (an AHAM-sourced CADR in a comparison table) is still read as a measurement by the shared plan-guided reader (9 sampled values; extends D15). Both stay unpersistable; Step 4 must not persist table or plan-guided readings before condition capture and a document-level declaration screen

the neutral acquisition 1F (decodedText/normalisedText, textContent semantics) joins text across
without a separator ("Dust: 134 CFM
Smoke: 126 CFM" -> "134 CFMSmoke"; the legacy text keeps a space), so 1G in-cell labels merge and lose the challenge pollutant. A fix changes the 1F contract and therefore the published 1G reading: it needs a new 1F version and a new 1G identity, not an edit (docs/plans/quantity-knowledge.md §6)
openDebt.resolution: 2026-10-18: acquisition v1f.2 adds renderedText (innerText-like, user-agent display only; 2063 of 2063 retained and fixture cells equal Chromium innerText, scripts/rendered-text-1f-verify.mjs); 1G v1g.2 ({text:'rendered'}) reads it. v1f.1 and v1g.1 stay the defaults and byte-identical on all 69 retained pages; on the sealed 1E/1G gold v1g.2 scores identically; across the retained pages 34 merged in-cell labels drop to 0 and 73 bare numbers recover their unit. The quantity-knowledge layer reads v1g.2

openDebt.item: the role of a quantity in a request (a requirement on the product, a fact about something owned, a usage context) is not understood: on the frozen request gold 29 of 76 product requirements stay silent, 13 of them exact values without a bound word and the rest in units the knowledge does not hold yet (ampere, ohm, bytes, grit); the bounded reader surfaces 5 non-requirements ("had them for at least 4 years"). The quantity knowledge types the quantity; it cannot decide its role

seven closed unit vocabularies remain in the operational readers (phase145, 166, 245, 253, 265, 272 and the 1G lexicon); they disagree on 15 of 34 printed units (evaluation/quantity-knowledge/lexicon-audit.json): dBA and dB(A) are collapsed to dB by 272, 245 and 1G (265 keeps dBA but not dB(A)), kWh/annum is read as energy and L/day as a volume by 1G. Only the Phase253 rate guard consults the quantity knowledge on the default path; each other vocabulary becomes a view of the pack only after an equivalence run on the retained pages shows no lost behaviour

comparability by quantity kind, metric, weighting, basis and conditions (compareQuantities) is demonstrated on retained readings and tests but consumed by no decision on the default path: Phase268/271 comparability and the catalog keep their own checks. 40 of 60 acoustic table values stay kind-ambiguous under qk.1 (still 40 under qk.2.1: the qk.2 inference that resolved 17 of them from the evidence class was withdrawn, KN K8 2026-10-18) (sound pressure or sound power) because the page does not say which; they must stay incomparable, not be guessed

knowledge v2 (methods, relations, class scales) is read and reported but used by no decision: relation checks (16 consistent on spent pages) and typed classes do not reach the catalog, Phase268/271 comparability or ranking; class requirements in requests are stated as unassessed objectives only, and need a registry category to resolve a scale shared by two regimes (a tumble dryer or fridge request keeps 'energy class B' ambiguous). Re-expressed dimension lists pair by closest value, not by axis or list position

1G (v1g.1 and v1g.2) reads a value glued to an axis letter in a dimension list as a truncated number ('19.87D x 27.16W x 12.38H inches' gives observations 19 and 12): found by the K9 regression check on 4 retained pages; the layer no longer gives such values a header unit, but the 1G observations themselves stay wrong until a new 1G version reads axis-suffixed numbers

the declarative rules decide document scope, context scope (since KR2: metric names, condition cues and methods are read only from context the scope rules apply), kind justification and comparability; open: kind discriminators (local) duplicate typed kindEvidence (scoped); no operational decision consumes the rule verdicts yet; no validation on unseen pages

on 7 unseen pages only 1 presents quantities in HTML tables (49 values); about 340 quantities sit in prose, lists or cards, and 2 manufacturer pages are client-rendered (data in JSON): the knowledge layer and its rules see none of them. In tables, conditions printed in cells of the same record (a rating-point grid: temperature and humidity per row) are not read as conditions of the record's results (13 of 15 missed), principle P1 found but not implemented; no relative-humidity kind

openDebt.item: outcomeAuthorised270 treats every 'measured_by' relation as establishing the outcome; source verification of 56 'measured_by' relations against the owner packages: 16 establish, 37 only inform, 3 unclear (evaluation/r1/relation-verification.json). Before ranking is unblocked the authority is graded (owner S68): direct evidence, partial contribution, indirect indicator, insufficient; a conclusion is authorised from the sufficiency of the whole evidence set, its conditions, the independence of its items and the user's need, never from one partial measure alone
openDebt.progress: R2 (2026-10-19, docs/plans/r2-typed-link-and-evidential-force.md): graded force implemented in shadow (KR program evidence, lk.1: direct, partial, indirect, not verified, conditions not shown; outcome assessment by direct evidence or by every listed contribution). outcomeAuthorised270 unchanged while ranking is blocked

openDebt.item: The S81 reasoning (kr81.2, link-rules v8) checks every condition the teaching requires, but no reader records most of them: on the S80 pages (spent), of 153 conditions required for 63 linked values, 65 have no quantity-knowledge axis and need concept-level capture that no reader performs, 15 are typed but not stated, 38 typed and shown, 35 identity. The operational test-lead reader (Phase265) records conditions as protocol-specific codes (load_empty, duration_1h, setpoint_c, all_compartments) that the knowledge cannot consult, so the store rows cannot even be identified as empty-run or cooking-task energy (no load axis).

openDebt.item: ra.2 checks the conditions a measurement requires against KnowledgeDimension181.conditionsMet, a list the catalog itself declares; neither compileCatalog268 nor any reader derives it from the records of the original tests (which carry limitation codes, not condition states). The authorisation trusts a label instead of deriving what it permits (Phase265 lesson). kr81 can derive condition states from records, but catalogs do not carry them.
openDebt.progress: S81: reported, not changed (shadow mechanism only; ranking rules are owner decisions); S82: conditionsMetFromRecords derives met conditions from test records in shadow (owner: design and experimental verification authorised, public authorisations unchanged); S83: validity per observation (each required condition verified or not verifiable, with its origin); two answers kept apart: the dimension as compiled (every observation verifies, no documented difference) and the largest comparable group of complete tests of two or more products (incomplete tests never discard complete ones; one product's test never shows a comparison condition); traced on the ranking path as authorisationTrace.derivedConditions, shadow only (no public decision changed, VALIDATED_NEW_AUTHORISATIONS still empty); real catalog: 3 validated tests of one measurement that requires no condition, so no recovery is observable on real data yet

openDebt.item: The S88-S96 reading line (property definitions pd.5, definition_interpreter, definition_learning, scientific_entities, document_evidence qualitative evidence, table_interpreter1g relations, QK conditions, methods, relations and aspects beyond single words) is reachable only from evaluation scripts: neither the store-writing path (phase246-live-wave observations: Phase245 specifications, Phase225/226/265 test leads, Phase269/270 qualitative codes) nor adviseFromRequest253 imports it. QK typed conditions are computed in typeObservedValue and discarded before storage; knowledge_statements (6118 rows) are read only by the uncalled teachingCaveatsShadow; qualitative_observations270 has no reader; comparative_results271 rows never link a product. Nine phases of reading improvements were measured on a parallel harness and never reached a stored row or an answer; this was not listed as debt until S97.
openDebt.progress: S97: causal audit and shadow counterfactuals only (owner review 2026-10-20). Integration needs an owner decision: which reader becomes the single operational reader, and which fields the store must keep. S98 (owner decision 2026-10-20): one shared scientific reading path (scientific_reading98) for the operational extractors' observations, persisted in store v11 scientific_readings98 and read by the user path (Advice253.scientificEvidence98); both gated. The registry scientificCapabilities lists every scientific module with status, consumer and validation; tests/s98_integration_fitness.test.ts fails when a capability is unregistered, claimed operational without runtime reachability, or shadow without naming this debt. S98 validation: spent S89-S96 (post hoc) 380 correct / 33 wrong / 50 false, rollback tables identical; independent check on 7 new pages (evaluation/s98/check-firstrun.json) 19 of 60 typed vs 0 baseline, 14 false under the sealed reference, 0 of 206 decisions changed. Kept gated (owner stop rule: false attributions); blockers in docs/plans/s98-operational-knowledge-path.md section 6. The debt stays open until the gated path is promoted or the shadow modules are integrated or retired.

authenticValidationRequirement.rule: Every major capability must eventually be validated on authentic external evidence on the operational path. Synthetic verification proves wiring, not reality. Each stage records its authentic validation as done (with the run that showed it) or pending (with what it waits for).

tiers.T1_synthetic: fictional fixtures; wiring and safety properties
tiers.T2_authentic_controlled: authentic evidence through the real components on a store copy, with an evaluation-only authority or proposed policy
tiers.T3_operational: authentic evidence through the operational path under authorised policy and authority

scientificCapabilities.note: S98 (owner decision 2026-10-20, item 8): every module with a scientific capability is registered with its integration status, a named consumer and a validation. 'operational' must be reachable at runtime (type-only imports excluded) from the operational entries; 'gated' from a gated entry; anything else is 'shadow' and must name its integration debt. tests/s98_integration_fitness.test.ts enforces this.
